articles.title_en: Blocking patents, rent protection and economic growth
articles.title_cn: 阻塞性专利、租金保护与经济增长
articles.abstract_en: We develop a Schumpeterian growth model to analyze the interaction between patent policy and firms' internal strategies to capture value from innovations. We consider two dimensions of patent policy: backward protection against imitation and forward protection, also known as blocking patents, against subsequent innovation that builds on a patented technology. Incumbent patent holders endogenously invest resources to protect their monopoly rents by impeding market entry of innovative competitors. We show that patent policy impacts economic growth through its influence on both the ex ante R&D incentives of potential innovators and the post-innovation rent protection incentives of incumbent firms. Most importantly, our analysis formalizes a novel growth-promoting role of forward protection; by guaranteeing previous innovators a share of future innovators' profits, forward protection reduces the incentive to actively obstruct follow-on innovations. We identify conditions under which the selective use of forward protection can stimulate economic growth through this mechanism.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个熊彼特增长模型，以分析专利政策与企业内部从创新中获取价值的策略之间的相互作用。我们考虑专利政策的两个维度：针对模仿的向后保护，以及针对在专利技术基础上进行后续创新的向前保护，也称为阻塞性专利。现有专利持有者内生地投入资源，通过阻碍创新竞争对手的市场进入来保护其垄断租金。我们表明，专利政策通过影响潜在创新者的事前研发激励和现有企业的事后租金保护激励来影响经济增长。最重要的是，我们的分析形式化了向前保护的一种新的促进增长的作用；通过保证先前创新者分享未来创新者的利润，向前保护减少了积极阻碍后续创新的激励。我们确定了通过这种机制选择性使用向前保护可以刺激经济增长的条件。

articles.title_en: Optimal taxation in the life cycle with human capital investment
articles.title_cn: 生命周期中人力资本投资的最优税收
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal taxes in a lifecycle model with unverifiable human capital investment inseparable from regular consumption. The planner faces asymmetric information regarding agents’ exogenous abilities and endogenous human capital. Agents deviate in two ways: misreporting ability and mis-investing in human capital. We characterize the distortions in a model with i.i.d. shocks and full human capital depreciation. Distortions are characterized by capital wedges that are positive over the life cycle, labor wedges that are negative early and positive later in the life cycle, and net human capital wedges that are positive in the life cycle. These wedges serve as mechanisms to eliminate the distortion to consumption due to inseparability from education expenditure. Calibrate to U.S. data, we show numerically that these results apply in a richer model with persistent shocks and non-full human capital depreciation. Simulation suggests that average capital wedges are positive in all working periods, with progressive capital wedges in contemporary skills, average labor wedges are negative in early and positive in later periods, with hump-shape in skills and nonzero at the top and the bottom of the skill distribution, and net human capital wedges are positive and regressive in skills, indicating that human capital subsidies are in favor of the high skilled.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在不可验证的人力资本投资与常规消费不可分离的生命周期模型中的最优税收。规划者面临关于代理人外生能力和内生人力资本的非对称信息。代理人以两种方式偏离：虚报能力和人力资本投资不足。我们在具有独立同分布冲击和完全人力资本折旧的模型中刻画了扭曲。扭曲通过生命周期中为正的资本楔子、早期为负后期为正的劳动楔子以及生命周期中为正的净人力资本楔子来表征。这些楔子作为消除因教育支出不可分离性导致的消费扭曲的机制。以美国数据进行校准，我们数值上表明这些结果适用于具有持久冲击和非完全人力资本折旧的更丰富模型。模拟表明，平均资本楔子在所有工作期间为正，且对当期技能具有累进性；平均劳动楔子在早期为负、后期为正，技能上呈驼峰形，在技能分布的顶端和底端非零；净人力资本楔子为正且对技能具有累退性，表明人力资本补贴有利于高技能者。

articles.title_en: Changing marital transitions and homeownership among young households
articles.title_cn: 年轻家庭的婚姻转变与住房拥有率
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows that the evolving likelihood of marriage and divorce is an important factor that helps account for the changes in homeownership rates among young single households and married couples from 1970 to the mid 1990s. To investigate potential mechanisms behind these observed changes, I develop and estimate a life-cycle model that incorporates housing decisions and age-dependent shocks associated with marriage and divorce. The findings indicate that the declined likelihood of marriage, along with increased returns on non-housing assets, helps generate the observed rise in homeownership among singles aged 25-44 years. Conversely, the increased likelihood of divorce, in addition to higher house prices and labor market volatility, contributes to the decrease in homeownership among young couples.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文表明，婚姻和离婚可能性的演变是解释1970年至1990年代中期年轻单身家庭和已婚夫妇住房拥有率变化的重要因素。为了探究这些观察到的变化背后的潜在机制，我开发并估计了一个生命周期模型，该模型纳入了住房决策以及与婚姻和离婚相关的年龄依赖冲击。研究结果表明，婚姻可能性的下降，加上非住房资产回报率的提高，有助于解释25-44岁单身人士住房拥有率的上升。相反，离婚可能性的增加，加上房价上涨和劳动力市场波动，导致了年轻夫妇住房拥有率的下降。

articles.title_en: Revisiting speculative hyperinflations in monetary models: A rejoinder
articles.title_cn: 货币模型中的投机性恶性通货膨胀再探讨：一个反驳
articles.abstract_en: In this note, we present a formal proof of Obstfeld and Rogoff's (1983, 2021) claim that their fractional-currency-backing scheme eliminates the inflationary equilibria in the money-in-utility model. To do so, we fully articulate the optimization problem of consumers who have the option to redeem (part or all of) their cash for a small amount of goods at any date. We also relate the scheme to the Fiscal Theory of the Price Level.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们正式证明了Obstfeld和Rogoff（1983，2021）的主张，即他们的部分货币支持方案消除了货币效用模型中的通胀均衡。为此，我们充分阐述了消费者的优化问题，这些消费者可以选择在任何日期用（部分或全部）现金赎回少量商品。我们还将该方案与价格水平的财政理论联系起来。

articles.title_en: Building the city under financial frictions
articles.title_cn: 金融摩擦下的城市建设
articles.abstract_en: Weak financial institutions may affect developing countries due to slowing the much-needed construction process of residential housing. Using novel data collected from Nairobi, I document considerable heterogeneity in the construction duration of new residential buildings, with about 40% of buildings started in 2009 still unfinished in 2018. To understand the role of financial development in constructing residential housing, I develop a heterogeneous agent model with financial frictions in which households construct individual housing units. Counterfactual simulations show that improvements in credit provision can substantially speed up the expansion of the aggregate housing stock and increase the city's density by enabling the construction of taller buildings. The model also predicts that investments in incomplete structures emerge as an alternative savings vehicle in the absence of reliable savings accounts.
articles.abstract_cn: 薄弱的金融机构可能因减缓急需的住宅建设进程而影响发展中国家。利用从内罗毕收集的新数据，我记录了新建住宅建筑建设时长的显著异质性，其中约40%于2009年开工的建筑在2018年仍未完工。为理解金融发展在住宅建设中的作用，我构建了一个具有金融摩擦的异质性主体模型，其中家庭建造各自的住房单元。反事实模拟表明，信贷供给的改善可以显著加快总住房存量的扩张，并通过允许建造更高建筑来提高城市密度。该模型还预测，在缺乏可靠储蓄账户的情况下，对未完工结构的投资会成为一种替代性储蓄工具。

articles.title_en: Unmarried births: Accounting and equilibrium analysis, 1960-1995
articles.title_cn: 非婚生育：核算与均衡分析，1960-1995
articles.abstract_en: The share of births to unmarried women in the U.S. rose well above 30% in the 1990s, despite unmarried women having greater access to abortion and improved birth control. We show that an equilibrium matching model in which unmarried couples behave co-operatively can explain 97% of the rise in the UMB ratio as the response to a combination of well-documented shocks: rising divorce rates, access to abortion, and improved contraception. Equilibrium interactions among these factors are important; had the marital surplus remained constant, very little change in unmarried births would have occurred. We also find that reforms reversing accessibility of birth control or abortion would on their own do little to reverse these social trends.
articles.abstract_cn: 在美国，尽管未婚女性获得堕胎和改善避孕的机会更多，但未婚女性生育的比例在1990年代仍升至30%以上。我们证明，一个未婚伴侣合作行为的均衡匹配模型可以解释非婚生育比例上升的97%，这是对多种有据可查的冲击的响应：离婚率上升、堕胎可及性和避孕改善。这些因素之间的均衡互动很重要；如果婚姻剩余保持不变，非婚生育的变化将非常小。我们还发现，逆转避孕或堕胎可及性的改革本身对这些社会趋势的逆转作用甚微。
